sections.content: The View Transitions API animates between DOM states natively: document.startViewTransition(() => updateDOM()) morphs elements with shared names via view-transition-name.
No library needed for page navigations, theme switches, and list reordering — the browser interpolates old/new snapshots. Pair with CSS ::view-transition-old/new pseudo-elements for custom easing.
Key points: needs JS trigger but zero dependencies, fallback is instant swap, and it excels at theme toggles and SPA route changes.
